name: OpenGameArt
description: Game-focused art catalogue with multiple open licences across 2D, 3D, audio and related content. Commercial reuse is asset/licence specific and requires exact-item checking.

licence.identifier: Mixed open licences per asset (including CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, OGA-BY and GPL families)
licence.notice: OpenGameArt permits commercial use under the specific asset licence. Conditions vary materially: attribution, share-alike, DRM/platform compatibility and GPL implications can apply. Exact asset licence must be selected and preserved before adoption.

provenance.notes: The site requires licensing information and provides attribution notices, but community uploads mean exact-asset authorship/source evidence must be reviewed before production adoption.

maintenance.evidence: Official FAQ and catalogue remain live and document current licence handling.
maintenance.notes: Qualification is for discovery only; every exact asset gets independent licence/provenance review.

compatibility.notes: Platform compatibility can be constrained by licence terms such as attribution/share-alike/DRM as well as technical format.

risk.legalNotes: Mixed licences require exact-item review. CC-BY/CC-BY-SA and GPL-family entries can introduce attribution, redistribution, share-alike, DRM or source/licensing compatibility concerns. Prefer CC0/clearly compatible entries when quality is equivalent.
risk.securityNotes: Community-hosted downloads; treat archives/files as untrusted inputs and validate before import.

assessment.notes: High-value discovery surface because it is game-specific, but the gate must never lift catalogue-level qualification into asset-level approval.

evidence.notes: Official FAQ states commercial projects may use site art subject to the chosen asset licence and explains licence-specific obligations.

publication.notes: Public page must prominently explain mixed per-asset licensing and avoid describing the catalogue as uniformly licence-safe.
